from tslearn.backend import get_backend

backend = None
for arg in [("numpy",), (X,), ()]:
    try:
        backend = get_backend(*arg)
        break
    except Exception:
        pass

assert backend is not None, "get_backend failed with all attempted arguments"

backend_str = str(type(backend)).lower() + str(backend).lower()
assert "numpy" in backend_str, f"Expected numpy backend, got {backend}"

print(f"__CHECK__ get_backend {type(backend).__name__}")
